statements.text: Last fall, President Biden launched a National AI Talent Surge to recruit AI professionals and bring their experience, expertise, and vision into government. The goal of this talent surge is to execute on the bold priorities he set out in his executive order to promote the safe, secure, and trustworthy development and use of AI.
